Title: Micronaut doesn't set a maximum redirect count for its HTTP Client, enabling infinite loop DoS
Description: The Netty-based Micronaut HTTP Client does not impose a limit on HTTP redirections, potentially allowing an infinite redirect loop that could lead to a denial-of-service attack.
AffectedVersions: All versions before 3.10.7, all versions starting from 4.0.0-M1 before 4.10.24, all versions starting from 5.0.0-M1 before 5.0.1
NotImpacted: All versions starting from 3.10.7 before 4.0.0-M1, all versions starting from 4.10.24 before 5.0.0-M1, all versions starting from 5.0.1
